name: dometrain
description: Dometrain course-content grounding skills for a Dometrain MCP server: search lessons, pull curated lesson documents with on-screen code, and cite timestamped deep links. Requires an active Dometrain Pro subscription. Ships no server: install dometrain-mcp for the bundled one, or configure your own user-scope dometrain server. Includes a setup check and a grounding usage skill kept in sync with Dometrain's own official Claude Code plugin.
